Decompose a project vision into quests

Top of the Quest hierarchy: Genesis -&gt; Quests -&gt; Tasks. Takes a project vision and produces a set of scoped quests via an AI planner agent.

Aliases: `g`

```sh
woco genesis [vision] [flags]
```

Modifies project state. Supports `--dry-run`.

## Arguments

| Argument | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `vision` | no | Project vision text |

## Flags

| Flag | Alias | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--tech-stack` |  | string |  | Tech stack description (e.g. "React, Node, Postgres") |
| `--constraint` |  | string |  | Constraint (can be repeated) |
| `--model` | `-m` | string |  | Model for the planner agent |
| `--no-tui` |  | boolean | `false` | Skip TUI review, auto-approve all quests |
| `--dry-run` |  | boolean | `false` | Show what would happen without creating quests |

## Global flags

| Flag | Alias | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--output` | `-o` | string | `"text"` | Output format: text (default), json, or toon. Values: `text`, `json`, `toon`. |
| `--force` |  | boolean | `false` | Force overwrite / skip safety prompts |
